title: From intent to input
description: An injected environment value, paced typing and a tape-local clipboard become an edited release name. Repeated Down, Tab and Ctrl+P reach the application as exact terminal bytes.
expected: release-candidate-1; two Down sequences, Tab, Ctrl+P and Enter; visible editing cursor, then hidden completion cursor.

title: Text with character
description: A compact specimen of emphasis, truecolor, indexed color, combining accents, CJK, box drawing and block graphics. Underline and strikethrough currently do not render; see https://github.com/joshka/betamax/issues/151.
expected: Style spans preserve emphasis and colors; combining/CJK cells remain intact; mint glyphs render. Known gap: underline and strike are state-only (issue #151).

title: Room to breathe · dark
description: A file list framed by padding, an outer margin, colorful window controls and rounded corners in Catppuccin Mocha.
expected: 900 × 540 pixels; margin and panel colors occupy the correct regions; content matches the light layout.

title: Room to breathe · light
description: The same file list in GitHub Light Default, with right-aligned window controls. Compare it directly with the dark page.
expected: Identical terminal text and grid dimensions; light panel, dark margin and right-side window controls.

title: Present the action
description: A caption and a Ctrl+L key chip annotate the same terminal page without changing its state. Open the checkpoints to compare clean, captioned and annotated frames.
expected: State JSON is identical across all checkpoints; caption and chip changes stay below the terminal; clearing after chip expiry restores the clean image.

title: Reveal the result
description: A deliberately magenta setup screen is captured by State and Screenshot while hidden. Show reveals only the finished checklist in the animation.
expected: Hidden checkpoint is magenta; every decoded animation frame excludes magenta; visible state contains only the prepared result.

title: Keep the history
description: Twenty-four archive entries scroll off the viewport. An alternate-screen review temporarily replaces them, then restores the original viewport and history.
expected: Archive entries survive across viewport plus scrollback; alternate content is distinct; restored state and pixels match the primary checkpoint.
